info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Platform & System
info.description:
Platform and system-level configuration from Cisco-IOS-XE-native model.

**Includes:** boot, memory, location, banner, clock, default, hardware, stack-power, upgrade, setup, exception, card, hw-module, module, software, system, power

**Modules covered:** Cisco-IOS-XE-power (Power over Ethernet / power supply)

**Key Features:**
- Boot configuration
- System banners
- Memory settings
- Hardware modules
- Software upgrade
- Platform settings
- PoE power management

**Base Path:** `/data/Cisco-IOS-XE-native:native/`

**Related:** See 'License' for software licensing

get.description:
Retrieve Power over Ethernet (PoE) and power supply configuration.

CLI equivalent: `show running-config | section power`

YANG module: Cisco-IOS-XE-power

Controls PoE inline power budgets, default consumption, logging, and power supply redundancy modes (combined, N+1, N+N).

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Limit the depth of returned sub-tree data (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.2). Use 'unbounded' for full depth.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Select specific fields to return (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.3). Example: fields=name;status

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Filter by config state: 'config' (config true only), 'nonconfig' (config false only), or 'all'.

error-tag.description: Enumerated error tag (e.g. invalid-value, data-missing, access-denied)

error-path.description: YANG instance-identifier of the error node
